en: In the year when Ryohei was eight, a small railway track began to be laid between Odawara and Atami.
u.src: 在良平八岁那一年，小田原和热海中间开始铺设小火车轨道。

en: Every day, Ryohei went to the edge of the village to watch the track-laying work.
u.src: 良平天天都去村边观看这项铺路工程。

en: The so-called work was really nothing more than hauling earth in carts; of course, Ryohei had gone to watch precisely because he was fascinated by the carts carrying the earth.
u.src: 所谓的工程，其实只不过是用斗车装运土方——当然良平正是对矿车装运土方这事儿很感兴趣才跑去围观的。

en: Each time the mine cart had been loaded with earth, the two young workers would climb onto it.
u.src: 每次矿车上装好了土，矿车两个小工就会站到矿车上。

en: The mine cart would follow the slope of the mountain downhill and go racing off without anyone pushing it.
u.src: 矿车顺着山势走下坡路，无需人力就能飞跑起来。

en: The mine cart rattled forward, its base shaking, while the hems of the workers' jackets fluttered in the wind and the long narrow track wound on ahead. Watching the scene, Ryohei felt a strong desire to become an earthwork laborer himself.
u.src: 矿车晃动着车的底座往前走，工人们外衣的下摆随风飞扬，狭长的路轨蜿蜒向前——良平望着这副情景，心里很想去当个土方工人。

en: He badly wanted to ride in the mine cart with those workers, even if only once.
u.src: 他心里很想和那些工人一起坐一次矿车，哪怕就一回呢。

en: When the mine cart reached the flat ground at the edge of the village, it came to a stop there on its own.
u.src: 矿车开到村边的平地上，就自然地停在那里了。

en: At the same time, the workers nimbly jumped down from the cart, and in no time they had dumped all the earth from it at the end of the track.
u.src: 同时，工人们很轻巧地从矿车上跳下来，片刻功夫，就把车上里的土全部倾倒在轨道的尽头处了。

en: Then the workers pushed the mine cart step by step, climbing back up the slope along the way they had come.
u.src: 接着，工人们便一步步推着矿车，沿着来的时候的路爬坡上山。

en: At that moment Ryohei thought that even if he could not ride in the mine cart, it would still be wonderful just to push it a little.
u.src: 这个时候良平心想，就算乘不了矿车，只要能推推它也是很好的呀。

en: One evening, probably in early February,
u.src: 有一天傍晚——约莫是二月上旬时，

en: Ryohei took along his younger brother, who was two years younger than he was, and a neighbor's child about the same age as his brother,
u.src: 良平带着小自己两岁的弟弟，还有一个和弟弟一般大小的邻居家的小孩，

en: and went with them to the edge of the village where the mine carts stood.
u.src: 一起到停着矿车的村边去。

en: The mine carts were caked with mud and lined up in the dim twilight.
u.src: 矿车粘满了泥巴并排列在昏暗的暮光之中。

en: Apart from those carts, the workers were nowhere to be seen.
u.src: 除了这些矿车之外，工人们都不知所踪。

en: The three children timidly went to push the cart at the very end.
u.src: 三个孩子战战兢兢地去推最边上的一辆矿车。

en: When the three pushed together, the cart suddenly lurched with a rumble, and its wheels began to turn.
u.src: 三个人合力一推，矿车突然“咕隆”一晃，车轮开始转动起来了。

en: The sound startled Ryohei so badly that he broke out in a cold sweat.
u.src: 这一声响吓得良平冒了一身冷汗。

en: But when the wheels rumbled a second time, Ryohei was no longer afraid.
u.src: 但是车轮第二次发出“咕隆”的声响时，良平已经不再恐惧了。

en: Rumble, rumble. As the three pairs of hands pushed the cart together, it too slowly climbed upward along the track with that sound.
u.src: “咕隆”，“咕隆”……三个人的手合力推着矿车，矿车也随着这声响缓缓地沿着轨道向上爬。

en: Before long, the mine cart had gone about ten or twenty meters, and then the slope of the track suddenly became very steep.
u.src: 没一会儿，矿车走出了约莫一二十米，这个时候，轨道的坡度突然变的很陡。

en: No matter how hard the three of them pushed, the mine cart would not move at all, and they were very likely to slide back down with it to where they had started.
u.src: 无论三个人怎么使劲推，矿车也一动不动，而且很可能三个人会随着矿车一起滑落回到原处。

en: After observing the situation, Ryohei decided it was all right, and began giving orders to the two children who were two years younger than he was.
u.src: 良平观察之后觉得可以了，于是就跟比自己小两岁的两个小孩发号施令。

en: Come on, get in the cart!
u.src: “来吧，上车吧！”

en: They let go together and jumped onto the mine cart.
u.src: 他们一起松开了手，跳上矿车。

en: At first, the mine cart only slid slowly downward,
u.src: 开始，矿车只是缓慢下滑，

en: Then it went faster and faster, and in an instant slid down along the rails.
u.src: 然后，速度越来越快，一下子就从轨道上滑了下去。

en: The scenery along the way seemed to split apart to both sides as if cleaved in two, rapidly opening out before their eyes.
u.src: 沿途风景就像被一劈而二似地向两侧分开，在他们眼前迅速铺开。

en: The evening breeze brushed their cheeks, and the mine cart seemed to fly beneath their feet; Ryohei felt as if he were floating in bliss and was utterly delighted.
u.src: 晚风吹拂者脸颊，脚下矿车飞舞——良平觉得自己飘飘欲仙，开心极了。

en: However, after only two or three minutes, the mine cart returned to its starting point and stopped.
u.src: 不过，也就过了两三分钟，矿车回到了原点，停了下来了。

en: Let's do it one more time.
u.src: “咱们再来一次吧。”

en: Ryohei took the two children, who were two years younger than him, and wanted to push the mine cart once more.
u.src: 良平带着这两个比自己还小两岁的孩子，想要再推一次矿车。

en: Before the wheels had even begun to turn, the sound of footsteps suddenly came from behind.
u.src: 车轮还没开始转动，突然背后传来了脚步声声。

en: Not only that: no sooner had he heard the footsteps than the sound immediately turned into angry shouting.
u.src: 不仅如此，才刚听到脚步声，这声音立刻就变成了愤怒的叫骂声。

en: Where did you little brats come from!
u.src: “哪里来的野孩子！

en: Who said you could move the mine cart?
u.src: 谁让你们动矿车的？”

en: A tall worker stood there, wearing an old coat and an out-of-season straw hat on his head.
u.src: 一个高个子工人站在那里，身着一件旧上衣，头上戴着一顶不合时节的麦秸草帽。

en: As soon as he saw the workman, Ryohei had already fled more than ten meters away with the two children.
u.src: ——一看到这个工人，良平带着两个小孩儿早就逃到十来米开外了。

en: From then on, even when Ryohei happened to pass that place on some errand and saw a trolley standing at the deserted work site, he no longer wanted to touch it.
u.src: ——自此以后，良平偶尔有事经过那里时，就算看到矿车停在没人的工地上，也不想再去碰矿车了。

en: And the figure of the workman who had scolded him remained in Ryohei's mind.
u.src: 而那个骂过自己的工人的模样，一直留在良平的脑海里。

en: A small yellow straw hat was always appearing in the darkness of night.
u.src: 一顶小小的黄色的麦秸草帽，在夜幕中总是浮现。

en: However, these memories also gradually grew hazy with time.
u.src: 不过，这些记忆随着时间，也慢慢的变模糊了。

en: One afternoon about ten days later, Ryohei stood alone at the construction site, watching from a distance as the trolley came toward him.
u.src: 过了十来天的一个午后，良平一个人站在工地上，远远望着矿车驶过来。

en: Besides the trolleys loaded with earth, there was another trolley carrying railroad ties, climbing the slope along the heavy rails laid for the main line.
u.src: 除了装土的矿车，还有一辆载着枕木的矿车，正沿着铺设干线用的粗轨往坡上爬。

en: Two young workers were pushing the trolley together.
u.src: 两个年轻的工人正合力推这辆矿车。

en: Watching the two of them, Ryohei felt that they had an approachable, friendly warmth about them.
u.src: 良平看着他们俩，觉得他们身上有一种平易近人的亲切感。

ja: ったりはしないだろう？
en: People like them probably will not scold me, right?
u.src: “他们这样的人，应该不会骂我吧？”

en: Thinking this, Ryohei ran straight toward the mine cart.
u.src: 良平这样想着，就直奔矿车跑去。

en: Uncles, shall I help you push the mine cart?
u.src: “叔叔，我来帮你们推矿车吧？”

ja: てうつむき、トロッコを
en: Among them, one worker in a striped shirt, bent over pushing a mine cart, did indeed answer readily at once without even raising his head.
u.src: 其中，一个穿着条纹衬衣正埋头推着矿车的工人，果然，头都没抬一下就马上爽快地答了话。

en: Sure, come help us push it together.
u.src: “好啊，来帮忙一起来推吧。”

en: Ryohei stood between two male workers and pushed the cart with all his strength.
u.src: 良平站在两个男工人中间，费尽全力地推起车来。

en: I didn't expect a little kid like you to be so strong.
u.src: “没想到你这小孩子还挺有力气呀。”

en: Another male worker, who had a cigarette tucked behind his ear, also praised Ryohei lavishly.
u.src: 另外一个耳朵上夹着一支香烟的男工人，也对良平赞不绝口。

en: After they had pushed for a while, the slope of the track gradually became gentler.
u.src: 推了一会儿之后，轨道的坡度逐渐变得平缓起来。

en: Would they soon say, "We do not need to push anymore"?
u.src: “已经不用再推了。”——他们会不会很快说这句话呢？
良平心里忐忑不安。

en: But the two young workers still kept pushing the mine cart in silence, only straightening their backs a little.
u.src: 可是那两个年轻的工人还是默默地继续推着矿车，只是微微把腰挺直了一些。

ja: はついにこらえきれず、
en: At last Ryohei could not hold back and asked timidly, "Are we going to keep pushing the cart uphill?"
u.src: 良平终于忍不住胆怯的问：“接着往上推车吗？”

en: the two workmen said in unison.
u.src: “再好不过啦。”两个男工异口同声的说道。

en: Ryohei thought to himself, "They really are thoroughly kind people."
u.src: 良平心想：“他们可真是亲切十足的人呢。”

en: After they pushed on for roughly another five or six hundred meters, the track once again reached a very steep slope.
u.src: 接着往推了约莫五六百米的距离，轨道再次到了坡度很陡的地方。

en: On both sides around here were mandarin orange orchards, and many golden-yellow fruits were basking in the sunlight.
u.src: 这一代两旁都是蜜橘园，很多黄澄澄的果实沐浴在阳光下。

en: Uphill is better after all; that way they can keep letting me push the mine cart.
u.src: “还是走上坡路好，这样的话他们就能够一直让我跟着推矿车啦。”

en: Thinking this to himself, Ryohei pushed the mine cart with all his might.
u.src: ——良平心里一边想，一边拼命推矿车。

en: After they pushed it upward from around the mandarin orange grove to the highest point, the track immediately became a downhill slope.
u.src: 从蜜橘园一带向上推到最顶点，轨道立马变成了下坡路。

en: The worker in the striped shirt called out to Ryohei, "Hey, get on with us."
u.src: 身穿条纹衬衣的工人对良平喊了声：“喂，一起上车吧。”

en: Ryohei immediately lifted his foot and jumped onto the mine cart.
u.src: 良平马上抬脚跳上矿车。

en: Just as the three of them had climbed into the mine cart,
u.src: 三个人刚登上矿车，与此同时，

en: the mine cart was already fanning the fragrance of the mandarin orange grove as it swiftly slid down along the track.
u.src: 矿车已扇动着蜜橘园里的香气，飞快地从轨道上滑了下去。

en: "Riding in a mine cart is much more fun than pushing one."
u.src: “乘矿车比推矿车要快乐更多呢。”

en: Ryohei let the wind billow out his jacket and thought about that obvious truth.
u.src: ——良平让自己的外衣鼓着风，想着这理所当然的道理。

en: "The farther we push the mine cart, the longer we will get to ride it on the way back."
u.src: “推着矿车走的路越多，回来时乘矿车的时间也越多。”
——良平也这么想。

en: The mine cart reached the bamboo grove area and gradually came to a stop.
u.src: 矿车到了竹林地区，渐渐地停了下来。

en: The three of them again got down as before and began pushing the heavy mine cart onward.
u.src: 三个人又像刚才一般，开始下车继续推这辆沉重的矿车。

en: At some point, the bamboo grove had disappeared, replaced by a mixed wood.
u.src: 不知何时起，竹林消失了，取而代之的是杂树林。

en: The gently rising road was piled with fallen leaves, almost burying the iron rails that had rusted red.
u.src: 缓缓上坡的路上堆满了落叶，几乎淹没了锈得发红的铁轨。

en: Pushing the mine cart along this road, they finally managed to reach the top of the slope.
u.src: 沿着这条路推着矿车，好不容易才登上坡顶。

en: Standing at the top of the slope, blue haze and the vast chill-tinged sea slowly opened out before their eyes.
u.src: 站在坡顶，蓝色的霞光、带着寒意的辽阔的大海在眼前徐徐展开。

en: At that moment, Ryohei immediately realized that he had gone a little too far.
u.src: 这个时候，良平立刻意识到，自己走的有点太远了。

en: The three of them got into the mine cart together again, and it slid quickly down along the left bank by the sea, sometimes passing under the branches and leaves of the thicket.
u.src: 三个人再次一起乘上矿车，矿车在海的左岸迅速下滑，间或从杂树林的枝叶下钻过。

en: But by then Ryohei no longer felt the excitement he had had a little earlier.
u.src: 但是，良平这个时候已经没有刚才那种兴致盎然的心情了。

ja: ってくれたほうがいい。」
en: It would be better if the mine cart turned around and went back now, Ryohei silently began to pray in his heart.
u.src: “矿车现在掉头回去才更好。”——良平心里默默祈祷起来。

en: Of course, he himself understood very well that unless they reached their destination, neither the mine cart nor the people could go back.
u.src: 当然，他自己也很明白，如果不能到达目的地，不管是矿车还是人，都回不去。

en: Then the mine cart stopped in front of a teahouse backed by a quarried mountain, and the teahouse roof was thatched with reeds.
u.src: 接着，矿车在一个背靠着开凿过的山岳的茶馆前面停了下来，茶馆屋顶是茅草葺做的。

en: As soon as the two workers went into the shop, they chatted with the proprietress carrying a small child on her back while leisurely drinking tea and eating sweets.
u.src: 两个工人一走进店里，就一边和背着幼儿的老板娘聊天，一边悠然的喝茶用点心。

en: Ryohei paced around the mine cart by himself, feeling terribly restless inside.
u.src: 良平一个人在矿车四周踱步，内心无比焦躁。

en: The base of the mine cart looked very sturdy, and the mud that had splashed onto it on the way there had already dried.
u.src: 矿车的底座看起来是十分牢靠，来时路上飞溅到底座上的泥巴都干涸了。

en: After a while, they came out of the teahouse,
u.src: 过了一阵，他们从茶馆里走了出来，

en: and just before leaving, the worker who had had a cigarette tucked behind his ear (of course, by now the cigarette was gone)
u.src: 临走之前，那个耳朵上夹着一根香烟的工人，（当然，如今耳朵上已经没有香烟了。）

en: gave Ryohei a packet of plain sweets wrapped in newspaper.
u.src: 送给良平一包以报纸包裹的粗点心。
良平语气冷冷的回了一句：“谢谢。”

en: But he immediately realized that this cold tone of his was unfair to the worker.
u.src: 可是他立马察觉到自己的这种冷淡语气，对那位工人来说不公平。

en: As if to cover up his cold attitude, Ryohei grabbed one of the coarse sweets and stuffed it into his mouth.
u.src: 像是为了掩饰自己冷淡的态度，良平抓起一块粗点心塞进嘴里。

ja: んであったせいだろう、
en: Perhaps because they had been wrapped in newspaper, the sweets gave off a smell of printing ink.
u.src: 可能是用报纸包裹的原因吧，点心上散发着一股油墨味。

en: The three of them pushed the mine cart again, climbing up the gentle slope.
u.src: 三个人再次推着矿车在平缓的斜坡上往上爬。

en: Although Ryohei was pushing the mine cart, his mind had already begun thinking about something else.
u.src: 良平虽然推着矿车，但是他的心早就开始想别的事情了。

en: After following this slope all the way down and then descending to the foot of it, there was another teahouse here much like the one before.
u.src: 顺着这个山坡一路下行前再下到坡脚，这里又是一个和前面差不多的茶馆。

en: The two workers went into the teahouse, while Ryohei sat on the mine cart thinking only about getting back as soon as possible.
u.src: 两个工人进入茶馆，良平坐在矿车上，一心想着赶紧回去的事情。

en: The plum blossoms in front of the teahouse were in full bloom, but the sunlight falling on them was gradually fading.
u.src: 茶馆前面的梅花开得正盛，但洒在梅花上的阳光正日渐消散。

en: The sun is about to set behind the mountains.
u.src: “太阳就要落山了。”

en: When Ryohei thought of this, he felt he could not go on acting so blindly.
u.src: 良平想到这里，觉得不能这么盲目的做下去了。

en: From time to time he kicked the wheels with his feet, trying to set the mine cart moving,
u.src: 他不时用脚踢踢车轮，试图推动矿车，

en: even though he knew in his heart that he could never move it by himself, he still tried now and then--
u.src: 尽管他心里明白自己一个人根本无法推动，但还是不时试探——

en: He was only trying, just once, to ease the uneasiness in his own heart.
u.src: 他不过是来一次消除自己内心的不安情绪。

en: But after the two young workmen came out,
u.src: 但是两个小工哈出来之后，

en: they rested their hands on the mine cart's sleepers and said to Ryohei as if nothing were the matter:
u.src: 一边把手搭在矿车的枕木上，一边若无其事地对良平说：
“你可以先回去了。

en: The two of us are going to spend the night over on the other side today."
u.src: 今天我们两个要在对面住一夜。”

ja: するかもしれませんよ。
en: If you still have not gone home this late, your family may be worried.
u.src: “太晚还没回家的话，你家里人可能会担心呢。”

en: For an instant, Ryohei stood frozen.
u.src: 一瞬间，良平怔住了。

en: The sky was gradually growing dark, and although at dusk late last year he had once walked the road to Iwamura with his mother,
u.src: 天色逐渐昏暗，虽然说去年底黄昏的时候，自己曾和母亲一道儿赶路去过岩村，

en: today's distance was nearly three or four times as far, and on top of that he now had to walk home alone,
u.src: 但是今天的路途差不多有去年三四倍，况且如今自己必须一个人走回家去，

en: Ryohei suddenly realized how serious the situation was.
u.src: ——良平一下子意识到事情的严重性了。

en: He was on the verge of tears, but what good would crying do?
u.src: 他就快哭出来了，但是哭有什么用呢？

en: Ryohei knew that now was not the time to cry.
u.src: 良平知道现在还不是哭的时候。

en: After awkwardly bowing farewell to the two young workers, he ran back along the tracks as if his life depended on it.
u.src: 他别别扭扭的对这两个年轻的工人鞠躬告辞之后，就玩命般顺着轨道往回跑。

en: Ryohei no longer cared about anything, and ran for a while along one side of the tracks,
u.src: 良平什么都不顾了，他顺着轨道的一侧不停地奔跑了一阵，

en: when he suddenly realized that the package of sweets in his pocket was something of a burden,
u.src: 突然发觉兜里的那包点心有些累赘，

en: so he decisively threw the sweets to the roadside,
u.src: 他果断的把点心扔到了路边，

en: and then he took off the wooden-soled sandals on his feet and threw them away too.
u.src: 然后又把脚上的木底草履也脱下扔了。

en: In this way, although small stones dug into his thin cloth socks,
u.src: 这样，虽然小石子扎到薄薄的布袜子里了，

en: his feet actually felt much lighter when he ran.
u.src: 但是两只脚跑起来倒是轻快多了。

en: Ryohei could sense the sea right there on his left,
u.src: 良平能够感觉到海洋就在他的左边，

en: and just then he ran up a steep slope.
u.src: 他这时跑上了陡坡。

en: Tears kept threatening to well up in his eyes,
u.src: 眼泪不时要涌进眼眶，

en: and his whole face twisted up of its own accord.
u.src: 整张脸自然扭曲成一团。

en: Even if he forced back the tears,
u.src: 就算强忍住了泪，

en: his nose still would not stop sniffling.
u.src: 可是鼻子总也忍不住抽抽搭搭。

en: By the time Ryohei passed through the bamboo grove, the sunset that had filled Higane Mountain was already gradually fading away.
u.src: 良平穿越竹林的时候，洒满日金山的晚霞已经逐渐消散。

en: Ryohei grew more and more anxious and uneasy.
u.src: 良平心里越来焦躁不安。

en: Perhaps because things were different on the way there and the way back, the change in scenery also made him feel very uneasy.
u.src: 可能是因为去的时候和回的时候情况不一样，风景的差异也令让他心里很不安。

en: At that moment, Ryohei felt that his clothes were already soaked through with sweat,
u.src: 这个时候，良平感觉到衣服已经被汗水都湿透了，

en: but he still had to keep hurrying along desperately, just as before,
u.src: 可是自己还必须要和刚才一样继续拼命赶路，

en: so he simply took off his jacket too and threw it by the side of the road.
u.src: 于是他干脆把上衣也脱下来扔在路边了。

en: By the time he passed through the mandarin orange grove, the sky was growing darker and darker.
u.src: 经过蜜橘园的时候，天色越来越暗了。

en: As long as I can stay alive...
u.src: “只要能活下去——”

en: Holding on to that belief, Ryohei paid no attention to whether he stumbled or slipped, and simply kept hurrying on with all his might.
u.src: 良平抱着这样的信念，顾不上跌倒还是滑倒什么的，只是拼命继续赶路。

en: At last, in the distant evening haze, he saw the silhouette of the construction site at the edge of the village.
u.src: 终于在遥远的暮霭中看到村边工地的影子。

en: At that moment, Ryohei clenched his teeth and held back the urge to burst into loud sobs,
u.src: 这个时候，良平咬着牙忍住想大哭的念头，

en: He hung his head in dejection, but in the end he held back his tears and started running again toward home.
u.src: 他垂头丧气，但最后忍住了眼泪，又继续往家的方向奔跑起来。

en: When Ryohei ran into the village, the houses on both sides of the street had already lit their lamps.
u.src: 良平跑进村子的时候，街道左右两旁的人家都已经点了灯。

en: By the lamplight, Ryohei could clearly feel that he was drenched in sweat, with steam rising from his clammy head.
u.src: 借着灯光，良平清楚的感觉到自己浑身大汗，汗津津的头上直冒热气。

en: The women drawing water by the well and the men coming back after finishing their work in the fields,
u.src: 在井边汲水的妇女们，和从田里干完活归来的男人们，

en: when they saw Ryohei running up breathlessly, they all could not help asking with concern, “Hey, what happened to you?”
u.src: 看到良平气喘吁吁地跑来，都不由关心的问：“喂，你这是怎么了啊？”

en: But Ryohei said nothing and ran past the brightly lit houses, including the general store and the barber shop.
u.src: 然而良平却一声不吭，从从杂货店、理发店这些灯火通明的房屋前跑了过去。

en: After Ryōhei ran into his own house, he finally could not hold back and burst out crying with a loud wail.
u.src: 良平跑进自己家之后，终于忍不住“哇”的一声哭了出来。

en: At the sound of his crying, both his father and mother immediately ran to Ryōhei's side.
u.src: 哭声一下子让父母亲的都跑到良平身边来了。

en: His mother especially held Ryōhei in her arms and kept trying to comfort him.
u.src: 尤其是母亲，她抱着良平不住的安慰。

en: But Ryōhei thrashed his arms and legs and went on crying without stopping.
u.src: 可是良平却手脚不住的折腾，哭个不停。

en: Perhaps Ryōhei's crying was so violent that three or four women from nearby also came to the dim entrance of his house.
u.src: 可能是良平的哭声太激烈了，住在附近的三四个妇女也来到良平家昏暗的大门口来了。

en: Needless to say, his parents asked him why he was crying, and even the neighbors at the doorway kept asking too.
u.src: 父母亲自不必多说，就连门口的邻人也都一直问他哭的原因。

en: But no matter what anyone asked, Ryōhei said nothing and only cried his heart out.
u.src: 不过不管别人问什么，良平除了一门心思的嚎啕大哭之外，什么也不说。

en: Having run all the way home from such a faraway place while holding his breath,
u.src: 从那么遥远的地方提着一口气跑回家，

en: whenever he thought of everything he had gone through on the way, Ryōhei felt that
u.src: 只要想到自己路上经历的种种，良平觉得，

en: no matter how much he suffered, there was always some feeling he could not let go of lodged in his heart...
u.src: 不管自己怎么痛苦，总有一种无法释怀情绪堵在自己心理……

en: In the year when Ryohei was twenty-six, he moved to Tokyo to live there with his wife and children.
u.src: 良平在二十六岁的那一年，带着妻子儿女一起来到东京生活。

en: Now he works on the second floor of a magazine company, holding a red pen as he proofreads manuscripts.
u.src: 如今，他在一个杂志社的二楼，手里握着红笔做着校对稿件的工作。

en: Yet for some reason, Ryohei often remembers that incident from his childhood.
u.src: 可是，不知为何，良平时常会想起自己小时候的那件事情。

ja: わからないのだろうか
en: Does he truly not know why?
u.src: 真的不知道为什么吗？

en: Worldly life has worn Ryohei out in body and mind, and a road often appears before his eyes, just like the road from his childhood: dimly lit bamboo woods, an uneven slope, long and narrow, continuing in broken stretches.
u.src: ——俗世的生活让良平身心俱疲，他眼前常常浮现出一条路，就像小时候的那条路一样，路上竹林昏暗微明，坡道高低起伏，细细长长，断断续续。
